'''Beds''' are a [[Seabases_(Subnautica)#Miscellaneous Items|Miscellaneous Item]] that can be built using the [[Habitat Builder (Subnautica)|Habitat Builder]]. They serve as indoor decorative amenities that can be slept in. Three variants exist; the first being the '''"Basic Double Bed"''', the second is called '''"Quilted Double Bed"''' and the third is the '''"Single Bed"'''. The only difference between the Basic Double Bed and the Quilted Double Bed is that the quilted bed has a linen spread over its foot-end. The Single Bed is a smaller, cheaper variant, with only one pillow. Beds can be placed either in a [[Cyclops]], a [[Multipurpose Room (Subnautica)|Multipurpose Room]], an [[Observatory (Subnautica)|Observatory]], a [[ Moonpool]], or a [[Scanner Room (Subnautica)|Scanner Room]]. A few Beds can be found inside a [[Wrecks|Wreck]] in the [[Mountains]]. There are also Beds inside the [[Aurora]]; and one can also be found right below one of the [[Jellyshroom Cave]] entrances in the [[Degasi Seabases|Degasi Seabase]]. ==Uses== Beds are not just a cosmetic item - facing the bed brings up a context prompt, and "using" it allows the player to have [[Ryley Robinson]] go to sleep. This advances the in-game clock by a set amount, including advancing all timer-based actions (ex. recharging [[Battery (Subnautica)|batteries]] or waiting for plants to grow). While sleeping, food, water and oxygen levels are frozen; Ryley is completely safe during this period, even if he falls asleep in a burning Cyclops or an unpowered base with no air. The short animation for sleeping is of Ryley laying down followed by a fade to black, and then a short animation where he sits up and stretches. There is an invisible cooldown timer of 10 minutes on the action, during which the player cannot have Ryley sleep again. Otherwise, the player can sleep at any time as long as the timer is not active. Beds will prevent you from sleeping if the [[Aurora]] has not exploded; possibly a feature inserted to prevent the skip of the drive failure all together. The type of bed used has no mechanical effect on sleeping and is purely cosmetic. The bed is helpful for bases with low energy production, as docking a vehicle inside a moonpool to charge and then sleeping will usually fully charge the vehicle (though it depends on the vehicle's power level) without Ryley dying from oxygen deprivation. This only works at night.
